SELECT c.contract_id AS contractId, c.contract_name AS contractName, COALESCE(c.sign_amount, 0) AS signAmount, COALESCE(c.sign_time, c.create_time) AS signTime, c.owner_id AS ownerId, c.owner AS ownerName, c.contact_id AS contactId, c.contact_name AS contactName, c.account_name AS accountName FROM crm_contract c WHERE COALESCE(c.contract_status, '') NOT IN ('Draft', 'Terminated') AND COALESCE(c.sign_time, c.create_time)::date >= #{startDate}::date AND COALESCE(c.sign_time, c.create_time)::date <= #{endDate}::date
AND c.owner_id IN
#{oid}
ORDER BY COALESCE(c.sign_time, c.create_time) DESC
